'''Detiz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He became a member of the [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and in c. [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Detiz and a group of Brotherhood pirates landed on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[I-9]] in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. However, the pirates were all driven insane by the [[Darkstaff]], a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that was located on the asteroid. A short time afterward, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] traveled to I-9 while on a mission for the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]], and Detiz and other pirates attacked the [[Agent/Legends|agents]].
